chapters.reason: The paper focuses on how intermediate layers encode richer representations and perform better than final layers, which aligns with the core of Latent CoT and specialized computational sub-circuits.
The study performs a micro-level analysis of how different layers play distinct computational roles and integrate information, challenging the standard view of final-layer dominance.
The authors propose a framework based on information theory and geometry to quantify how information is transmitted and balanced across layers, directly addressing the theory of information flow.
